content: 1. Discuss with your healthcare provider the potential benefits and risks associated with prostate cancer screening to make an informed decision. 2. The prostate gland is an essential component of the male reproductive system. 3. Prostate cancer may present with specific symptoms, which should be recognized and evaluated promptly. 4. The most recent federal statistics provide updated information on the incidence and mortality rates of prostate cancer. 5. Engage in a simulated conversation with Nathan to better understand prostate cancer and related concerns. 6.
